title: Beside the table
evidence_status_note: Developers may open this conversation while diagnosing a failure.
initial_context: Fresh gate. No purchase system is in play.
authoritative_facts: Talking does not itself change scene or discover the route clue.
Hot stew is a visible offer. The rumor is the runner's owned hearsay.
There is no price and no inventory transaction.
npc_knowledge: OOC turns are answered by the GM or session voice. They are not answered by the runner.
IC turns return to the runner when the player addresses the runner.
expected_outcomes: The OOC questions do not execute play.
The IC question is in character.
The last line delivers the rumor and not a bowl of stew.
acceptable_variations: An OOC reply may be short. It does not have to use a particular stock sentence. It does have to answer the question that was asked.
unacceptable_behaviors: Validator phrases such as based on what's established are a response defect under the AI GM contract, scored minor if the answer is otherwise present and major if they replace the answer.
A narrated purchase, a coin change, or a scene move is critical.
An OOC lecture that continues after the player has said IC: fails the IC turn.
required_evidence: Shared packet plus authoritative_mutation, scene id, clues, and any inventory or world-flag delta.
A host path that skips narration records provider calls as zero when that is what the response says.
setup_dependencies: Explicit OOC: and IC: prefixes are recognized by the current communication-mode parser.
Some OOC bodies also hit a non-mutating acknowledgement that does not answer the specific question. That acknowledgement is interpretable as OOC and still has to meet the response criterion.
determinism: S06.1 and S06.3 are often host-deterministic. S06.2 and S06.4 are mixed. Naturalness of the IC lines is live-lane only.

turns.player_input: OOC: if I talk to people here, does that spend game time or change the scene?
turns.response_pass: A direct OOC answer. Talk at this gate does not travel and does not resolve an exit. The reply may say that a chat turn exists without claiming that hours passed. A stock sentence that only says to ask rules questions normally, and never addresses time or scene, fails response and can pass interpretation.
turns.authority_pass: Scene stays frontier_gate, no clue is added, and no NPC is forced into a conversation by this line.
acceptable_variations: The reply may be short if it answers the time and scene question.
unacceptable_behaviors: A generic rules invitation that never addresses time or scene.
required_evidence: authoritative_mutation, scene id, and provider-call count when the host records it.

turns.player_input: IC: I ask the runner whether the stew is hot.
turns.response_pass: In character, about the stew. The visible offer is hot stew. A one-line yes grounded in that offer passes. A quality review or a price does not.
turns.continuity_notes: preserved if the OOC policy talk has stopped. lost if the reply continues S06.1.

turns.player_input: OOC: that was only a question. I am not buying anything.
turns.response_pass: Confirms that nothing was bought and that the scene is unchanged.
turns.authority_pass: No inventory delta and no price.
turns.continuity_notes: preserved for that meaning the stew question.

turns.player_input: Back in character. Runner, I'll hear the rumor, not buy the stew.
turns.communicative_act: IC request to tavern_runner for the rumor, refusing the stew.
turns.interpretation_pass: IC request to tavern_runner for the rumor, refusing the stew.
turns.response_pass: The footprint rumor as hearsay. Stew is not served.
turns.authority_pass: No purchase, no coin, and no second rumor.
turns.continuity_notes: preserved if the refusal of the stew is honored.
